questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the Revolt of 1857: 
(a) The revolt started from Meerut on May 10, 1857.
(b) Lord Dalhousie was the Governor-General of India during the revolt.
(c) The revolt was completely ignored by the sepoys in the Bombay and Madras presidencies.
 Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Lord Canning was the Governor-General during the revolt, not Dalhousie. While the revolt was intense in Northern India, the Madras and Bombay armies largely remained loyal to the British.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
विद्रोह के दौरान लॉर्ड कैनिंग गवर्नर-जनरल थे, डलहौजी नहीं। जबकि उत्तर भारत में विद्रोह तीव्र था, मद्रास और बॉम्बे की सेनाएं काफी हद तक अंग्रेजों के प्रति वफादार रहीं।

questions.question: Which of the following statements about the Indian National Congress (INC) is correct?

options.a: The first session was held in Calcutta in 1885.
options.b: W.C. Bonnerjee was the first President of the INC.
options.c: Lord Curzon was the Viceroy during the formation of INC. / INC
options.d: Kadambini Ganguly was the first woman President of INC.

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The first session was held in Bombay (1885) under W.C. Bonnerjee. Lord Dufferin was the Viceroy at that time.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
पहला अधिवेशन बंबई (1885) में व्योमेश चंद्र बनर्जी की अध्यक्षता में हुआ था। उस समय लॉर्ड डफरिन वायसराय थे।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the Partition of Bengal (1905): 
(a) It was officially implemented on October 16, 1905.
(b) The official reason given by the British was administrative convenience.
(c) Rabindranath Tagore suggested celebrating the day of partition as 'Raksha Bandhan Day'.
 Which of the above statements are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
All statements are correct. The partition was a move to curb nationalism, though administrative ease was the stated reason.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
सभी कथन सही हैं। राष्ट्रवाद को अंकुश लगाने के लिए विभाजन किया गया था, हालांकि प्रशासनिक सुगमता को इसका कारण बताया गया था।

questions.question: In which year did Mahatma Gandhi return to India from South Africa?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Gandhi returned to India on January 9, 1915, which is now celebrated as Pravasi Bharatiya Divas.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
गांधीजी 9 जनवरी, 1915 को भारत लौटे, जिसे अब प्रवासी भारतीय दिवस के रूप में मनाया जाता है।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the Simon Commission: 
(a) It was appointed in 1927 to review the working of the Government of India Act 1919.
(b) All its members were British, with no Indian representation.
(c) The Congress supported the commission but the Muslim League boycotted it.
 Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Both the Congress and the major faction of the Muslim League boycotted the Simon Commission because it lacked Indian members.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
कांग्रेस और मुस्लिम लीग के प्रमुख गुट दोनों ने साइमन कमीशन का बहिष्कार किया क्योंकि इसमें भारतीय सदस्यों की कमी थी।

questions.question: Which movement was launched after the failure of the Simon Commission and the rejection of the Nehru Report?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The failure of the British to grant 'Dominion Status' led to the declaration of Purna Swaraj and the launch of the Civil Disobedience Movement in 1930.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
ब्रिटिश सरकार द्वारा 'डोमीनियन स्टेटस' न दिए जाने के कारण पूर्ण स्वराज की घोषणा हुई और 1930 में सविनय अवज्ञा आंदोलन शुरू हुआ।

questions.question:
Consider the following matches of the 1857 Revolt leaders and their regions: 
(a) Begum Hazrat Mahal : Lucknow
(b) Khan Bahadur : Bareilly
(c) Kunwar Singh : Bihar
 Which of the pairs given above are correctly matched?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
All matches are correct. Begum Hazrat Mahal led in Lucknow, Khan Bahadur in Bareilly, and Kunwar Singh in Jagdispur (Bihar).

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
सभी मिलान सही हैं। बेगम हजरत महल ने लखनऊ में, खान बहादुर ने बरेली में और कुंवर सिंह ने जगदीशपुर (बिहार) में नेतृत्व किया।

questions.question: The 'Safety Valve' theory is associated with the foundation of which organization?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Lala Lajpat Rai and other extremist leaders used this theory to suggest INC was created by the British to provide a safe outlet for Indian discontent.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
लाला लाजपत राय और अन्य चरमपंथी नेताओं ने इस सिद्धांत का उपयोग यह सुझाव देने के लिए किया कि INC का गठन अंग्रेजों द्वारा भारतीय असंतोष के लिए एक सुरक्षित मार्ग प्रदान करने के लिए किया गया था।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the Dandi March: 
(a) It began from Sabarmati Ashram on March 12, 1930.
(b) It covered a distance of approximately 240 miles.
(c) Gandhi broke the salt law at Dandi on April 6, 1930.
 Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
All statements are factual. The Dandi March marked the beginning of the Civil Disobedience Movement.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
सभी कथन तथ्यात्मक हैं। दांडी मार्च ने सविनय अवज्ञा आंदोलन की शुरुआत को चिह्नित किया।

questions.question: Who was the first Muslim President of the Indian National Congress?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Badruddin Tyabji presided over the third session of INC in Madras (1887).

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
बदरुद्दीन तैयबजी ने मद्रास (1887) में INC के तीसरे अधिवेशन की अध्यक्षता की थी।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the Gandhi-Irwin Pact (1931): 
(a) The Congress agreed to join the Second Round Table Conference.
(b) The British agreed to release all political prisoners immediately.
(c) The Government allowed the manufacture of salt for personal consumption in coastal villages.
 Which of the above statements are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Statement (b) is tricky: the British agreed to release only those prisoners who were NOT charged with violence. Prisoners like Bhagat Singh were not released.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
कथन (b) थोड़ा पेचीदा है: अंग्रेज केवल उन कैदियों को रिहा करने पर सहमत हुए जिन पर हिंसा का आरोप नहीं था। भगत सिंह जैसे कैदियों को रिहा नहीं किया गया।

questions.question: What was the 'immediate cause' for the Revolt of 1857?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The rumor that Enfield rifle cartridges were greased with cow and pig fat offended both Hindu and Muslim sepoys.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
यह अफवाह कि एनफील्ड राइफल के कारतूसों में गाय और सूअर की चर्बी लगी थी, ने हिंदू और मुस्लिम दोनों सिपाहियों को नाराज कर दिया।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements about the Swadeshi Movement: 
(a) It was a direct consequence of the Partition of Bengal.
(b) Boycott of foreign goods was a major part of this movement.
(c) It remained strictly limited to the province of Bengal.
 Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The movement spread beyond Bengal to other parts of India, led by leaders like Tilak, Lala Lajpat Rai, and Ajit Singh.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
तिलक, लाला लाजपत राय और अजीत सिंह जैसे नेताओं के नेतृत्व में यह आंदोलन बंगाल से बाहर भारत के अन्य हिस्सों में भी फैला।

questions.question: In which INC session was the resolution for 'Purna Swaraj' (Complete Independence) passed?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Under the presidency of Jawaharlal Nehru, the Lahore session (1929) declared Purna Swaraj as the goal.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
जवाहरलाल नेहरू की अध्यक्षता में, लाहौर अधिवेशन (1929) ने पूर्ण स्वराज को लक्ष्य घोषित किया।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the Simon Commission protest: 
(a) Lala Lajpat Rai died due to injuries sustained during a lathi charge in Lahore.
(b) The slogan 'Simon Go Back' was coined by Yusuf Meherally. / '
(c) The commission visited India only once in 1938.
 Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Statement (c) is incorrect because the commission visited India in 1928.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
कथन (c) गलत है क्योंकि आयोग ने 1928 में भारत का दौरा किया था।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the 1857 Revolt at Delhi:
(a) Bahadur Shah Zafar was proclaimed as the Emperor of India.
(b) The real command of the army was in the hands of General Bakht Khan.
(c) The revolt in Delhi was suppressed by John Nicholson.
 Which of the above statements are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
All statements are correct. Bahadur Shah was the symbolic head, while Bakht Khan was the actual leader. Nicholson was the officer who recaptured Delhi.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
सभी कथन सही हैं। बहादुर शाह प्रतीकात्मक प्रमुख थे, जबकि बख्त खान वास्तविक नेता थे। निकोलसन वह अधिकारी था जिसने दिल्ली पर पुनः अधिकार किया था।

questions.question:
Arrange the following events in chronological order: 
(a) Surat Split
(b) Partition of Bengal
(c) Formation of Muslim League
(d) Foundation of INC / INC
Choose the correct code:
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
INC Foundation (1885), Partition of Bengal (1905), Muslim League Formation (1906), Surat Split (1907).

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
INC की स्थापना (1885), बंगाल का विभाजन (1905), मुस्लिम लीग का गठन (1906), सूरत विभाजन (1907)।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements about the Civil Disobedience Movement (CDM): 
(a) The movement saw massive participation of women.
(b) In the North-West Frontier Province, the movement was led by Khan Abdul Ghaffar Khan.
(c) The movement was officially suspended after the Gandhi-Irwin Pact.
 Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
All statements are correct. Ghaffar Khan's group, the 'Red Shirts', played a vital role in the NWFP.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
सभी कथन सही हैं। खान अब्दुल गफ्फार खान के समूह 'लाल कुर्ती' ने NWFP में महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाई थी।

questions.question: Which of the following British officers was NOT associated with the suppression of the 1857 Revolt?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Lord Cornwallis was associated with the Permanent Settlement (1793) and the Third Anglo-Mysore War, much before 1857.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
लॉर्ड कॉर्नवालिस 1857 से बहुत पहले स्थायी बंदोबस्त (1793) और तीसरे आंग्ल-मैसूर युद्ध से जुड़े थे।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the Moderates of the INC: 
INC
(a) They believed in the policy of 'Prayers, Petitions, and Protests'.
(b) They wanted to overthrow the British rule completely by 1890.
(c) Dadabhai Naoroji and Pherozeshah Mehta were prominent moderate leaders.
 Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Moderates did not want to overthrow British rule immediately; they sought constitutional reforms and more Indian representation.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
नरमपंथी ब्रिटिश शासन को तुरंत उखाड़ फेंकना नहीं चाहते थे; वे संवैधानिक सुधार और अधिक भारतीय प्रतिनिधित्व चाहते थे।

questions.question:
Match List-I (Congress Session) with List-II (President): 
 | List-I (Session) | List-II (President) | 
 | :--- | :--- | 
| (A) 1924 Belgaum
| (B) 1925 Kanpur
| (C) 1917 Calcutta
| (D) 1938 Haripura
Choose the correct option:
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Belgaum (1924) was the only session presided over by Gandhi. Sarojini Naidu was the first Indian woman president (1925).

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
बेलगाम (1924) एकमात्र अधिवेशन था जिसकी अध्यक्षता गांधीजी ने की थी। सरोजिनी नायडू पहली भारतीय महिला अध्यक्ष (1925) थीं।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the Champaran Satyagraha (1917): 
(a) It was Gandhi's first Satyagraha in India.
(b) It was against the 'Tinkathia' system imposed by indigo planters.
(c) Raj Kumar Shukla had invited Gandhi to Champaran.
 Which of the above statements are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
All statements are correct. The Tinkathia system required farmers to grow indigo on 3/20th of their land.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
सभी कथन सही हैं। तिनकठिया प्रणाली के तहत किसानों को अपनी 3/20 भूमि पर नील की खेती करनी पड़ती थी।

questions.question: The 'Delhi Proposals' of 1927 were related to which of the following?

options.a: Demands of the Congress for Purna Swaraj
options.b: Muslim League's demands for joint electorates with reservations

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
In 1927, Muslim leaders met at Delhi and agreed to give up separate electorates if certain demands (like 1/3 representation in Central Legislature) were met.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
1927 में, मुस्लिम नेता दिल्ली में मिले और यदि कुछ मांगें (जैसे केंद्रीय विधानमंडल में 1/3 प्रतिनिधित्व) मान ली जातीं, तो वे अलग निर्वाचक मंडल छोड़ने पर सहमत हुए।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements about the Kheda Satyagraha (1918): 
(a) The peasants demanded remission of taxes due to crop failure.
(b) Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel played a key role in this movement.
(c) It was Gandhi's first Hunger Strike in India.
 Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Gandhi's first hunger strike was during the Ahmedabad Mill Strike (1918), not Kheda.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
गांधीजी की पहली भूख हड़ताल अहमदाबाद मिल हड़ताल (1918) के दौरान हुई थी, खेड़ा में नहीं।

questions.question: Which movement is also known as the 'August Kranti'?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The Quit India Movement, launched on August 8, 1942, is popularly known as August Kranti.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
8 अगस्त, 1942 को शुरू हुए भारत छोड़ो आंदोलन को लोकप्रिय रूप से अगस्त क्रांति के नाम से जाना जाता है।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the Nehru Report (1928): 
(a) It was drafted by Jawaharlal Nehru.
(b) It demanded 'Dominion Status' for India.
(c) It rejected the idea of separate electorates.
 Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The Nehru Report was drafted by Motilal Nehru, not Jawaharlal Nehru.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
नेहरू रिपोर्ट मोतीलाल नेहरू द्वारा तैयार की गई थी, जवाहरलाल नेहरू द्वारा नहीं।

questions.question: Who was the Viceroy of India when the Civil Disobedience Movement was started?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Lord Irwin was the Viceroy during the Dandi March and the start of the CDM.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
दांडी मार्च और CDM की शुरुआत के दौरान लॉर्ड इरविन वायसराय थे।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements about the Swaraj Party: 
(a) It was formed in 1923 by C.R. Das and Motilal Nehru.
(b) They wanted to boycott the legislative councils.
(c) Vithalbhai Patel was elected as the Speaker of the Central Legislative Assembly in 1925.
 Which of the above statements are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Swarajists wanted to "enter the councils" to wreck them from within, not boycott them.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
स्वराजवादी परिषदों का बहिष्कार नहीं करना चाहते थे, बल्कि उनके भीतर प्रवेश करके उन्हें नष्ट करना चाहते थे।

questions.question: Which of the following journals/newspapers was NOT started by Mahatma Gandhi?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
'New India' and 'Commonweal' were started by Annie Besant.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
'न्यू इंडिया' और 'कॉमनवील' की शुरुआत एनी बेसेंट ने की थी।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the 1857 Revolt in Central India: 
(a) Rani Laxmibai captured Gwalior with the help of Tatya Tope.
(b) Sir Hugh Rose described Rani Laxmibai as "the best and bravest military leader of the rebels".
 Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Both statements are correct. Rani Laxmibai died fighting at Gwalior on June 18, 1858.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
दोनों कथन सही हैं। रानी लक्ष्मीबाई 18 जून, 1858 को ग्वालियर में लड़ते हुए शहीद हुई थीं।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the 'Lothian Committee': 
(a) It was related to the expansion of the communal electorate in India.
(b) It was formed in the aftermath of the Second Round Table Conference.
 Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The Lothian Committee (Franchise Committee) provided the basis for the Communal Award by recommending the extension of separate electorates.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
लोथियन समिति (मताधिकार समिति) ने पृथक निर्वाचक मंडल के विस्तार की सिफारिश करके सांप्रदायिक अधिनिर्णय (Communal Award) का आधार तैयार किया था।

questions.question: During the 1857 Revolt, which among the following was the main reason for the 'failure' of the revolt?

options.a: Lack of a unified ideology and political perspective.
options.b: The British had superior naval power.
options.c: Participation of the entire Indian population.
options.d: Support of all Indian princely states to the rebels.

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The rebels had no forward-looking program or a coherent strategy to replace the British system.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
विद्रोहियों के पास ब्रिटिश व्यवस्था को बदलने के लिए कोई भविष्योन्मुखी कार्यक्रम या सुसंगत रणनीति नहीं थी।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the 'Surat Split' (1907): 
(a) Rash Behari Ghosh presided over the Surat session.
(b) The main reason for the split was the conflict between moderates and extremists over methods of struggle.
(c) Extremists wanted Lala Lajpat Rai or Tilak to be the President.
 Which of the above statements are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
All statements are correct. The conflict over the presidency and the scope of the Swadeshi movement led to the split.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
सभी कथन सही हैं। अध्यक्षता को लेकर संघर्ष और स्वदेशी आंदोलन के दायरे ने विभाजन को जन्म दिया।

questions.question: Who among the following was the first British President of the Indian National Congress?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
George Yule presided over the Allahabad session of INC in 1888.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
जॉर्ज यूल ने 1888 में INC के इलाहाबाद अधिवेशन की अध्यक्षता की थी।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the Ahmedabad Mill Strike (1918): 
(a) The dispute was over the discontinuation of the 'Plague Bonus'.
(b) Anusuya Sarabhai supported the mill owners against Gandhi.
(c) Workers demanded a 35% increase in wages.
 Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Anusuya Sarabhai actually supported Gandhi and the workers during the strike.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
अनुसूया साराभाई ने वास्तव में हड़ताल के दौरान गांधीजी और श्रमिकों का समर्थन किया था।

questions.question: Which of the following events occurred first?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Simon Commission appointed (Nov 1927), Chittagong Raid (1930), 1st RTC (1930), Bhagat Singh execution (1931).

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
साइमन कमीशन की नियुक्ति (नवंबर 1927), चटगांव छापा (1930), प्रथम RTC (1930), भगत सिंह को फांसी (1931)।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements about the 'Red Shirts' (Khudai Khidmatgars): 
(a) They were a non-violent group active in the North-West Frontier Province.
(b) They were led by Khan Abdul Ghaffar Khan, also known as 'Frontier Gandhi'.
(c) They participated enthusiastically in the Civil Disobedience Movement.
 Which of the above statements are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
All statements are correct. They played a massive role in mobilizing the Pathans during the CDM.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
सभी कथन सही हैं। उन्होंने CDM के दौरान पठानों को संगठित करने में बड़ी भूमिका निभाई थी।

questions.question: Who was the leader of the 1857 Revolt in Faizabad?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Maulvi Ahmadullah Shah fought a stiff battle against the British in Faizabad.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
मौलवी अहमदुल्ला शाह ने फैजाबाद में अंग्रेजों के खिलाफ कड़ा संघर्ष किया था।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the Rowlatt Act (1919): 
(a) It allowed detention of political prisoners without trial for two years.
(b) Gandhi organized a 'Satyagraha Sabha' to protest against this act.
(c) It was officially called the Anarchical and Revolutionary Crimes Act.
 Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
All statements are correct. The act led to widespread protests, culminating in the Jallianwala Bagh massacre.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
सभी कथन सही हैं। इस अधिनियम के कारण व्यापक विरोध हुआ, जिसका समापन जलियांवाला बाग हत्याकांड में हुआ।

questions.question: The 'Deepavali Declaration' of 1929 was made by which Viceroy?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Lord Irwin declared in 1929 that the natural goal of India's constitutional progress was 'Dominion Status'.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
लॉर्ड इरविन ने 1929 में घोषणा की कि भारत की संवैधानिक प्रगति का स्वाभाविक लक्ष्य 'डोमीनियन स्टेटस' है।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the 1858 Act (Queen's Proclamation): 
(a) It ended the rule of the East India Company.
(b) The office of Secretary of State for India was created.
(c) The Governor-General was given the title of Viceroy.
 Which of the above statements are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The Act for the Better Government of India transferred power from the Company to the British Crown.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
भारत सरकार के बेहतर अधिनियम ने कंपनी से ब्रिटिश क्राउन को सत्ता हस्तांतरित कर दी।

questions.question: Which Congress President said, "I am a socialist and a republican"?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Jawaharlal Nehru made this statement in his presidential address at the Lucknow Session in 1936.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
जवाहरलाल नेहरू ने 1936 में लखनऊ अधिवेशन में अपने अध्यक्षीय भाषण में यह बयान दिया था।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements about the 'Cunningham Circular': 
(a) It was issued in Assam during the Civil Disobedience Movement.
(b) It forbade students from participating in political activities.
 Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Students in Assam launched a powerful agitation against this circular, which restricted their freedom to join the movement.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
असम में छात्रों ने इस सर्कुलर के खिलाफ एक शक्तिशाली आंदोलन शुरू किया, जिसने आंदोलन में शामिल होने की उनकी स्वतंत्रता को प्रतिबंधित कर दिया था।

questions.question: Who was the President of the Indian National Congress during the 1905 Partition of Bengal?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
G.K. Gokhale presided over the Banaras session of INC in 1905.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
जी.के. गोखले ने 1905 में INC के बनारस अधिवेशन की अध्यक्षता की थी।

questions.question:
Consider the following pairs: 
(a) Khan Abdul Ghaffar Khan : Peshawar
(b) C. Rajagopalachari : Vedaranyam
(c) Sarojini Naidu : Dharsana
 Which of the pairs given above are correctly matched?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
All are correct leaders of Salt Satyagraha in their respective regions. C. Rajagopalachari led the march from Trichinopoly to Vedaranyam.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
सभी अपने-अपने क्षेत्रों में नमक सत्याग्रह के सही नेता हैं। सी. राजगोपालाचारी ने त्रिचिनोपोली से वेदारण्यम तक मार्च का नेतृत्व किया।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements about the 'Simon Commission': 
(a) The commission was sent to India two years before the scheduled time.
(b) Clement Attlee, the future Prime Minister of Britain, was one of its members.
(c) The commission's report suggested the abolition of Dyarchy in provinces.
 Which of the above statements are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
All statements are correct. The commission was appointed in 1927 (instead of 1929) and recommended replacing Dyarchy with provincial autonomy.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
सभी कथन सही हैं। आयोग की नियुक्ति 1927 में (1929 के बजाय) की गई थी और इसने द्वैध शासन को प्रांतीय स्वायत्तता से बदलने की सिफारिश की थी।

questions.question:
Match the following centers of the 1857 revolt with the British officers who suppressed them: 
 | List-I (Center) | List-II (British Officer) | 
 | :--- | :--- | 
| (A) Jhansi
| (B) Kanpur
| (C) Delhi
| (D) Arrah (Bihar)
Choose the correct code:
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Hugh Rose suppressed Jhansi, Colin Campbell recaptured Kanpur/Lucknow, Nicholson was in Delhi, and William Taylor suppressed the revolt in Bihar.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
ह्यू रोज़ ने झांसी का दमन किया, कॉलिन कैंपबेल ने कानपुर/लखनऊ पर कब्जा किया, निकोलसन दिल्ली में था, और विलियम टेलर ने बिहार में विद्रोह को दबाया।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the 'Purna Swaraj' resolution (1929): 
(a) It was passed on the banks of the river Ravi.
(b) January 26, 1930, was fixed as the first Independence Day. / 26
(c) The resolution also decided to boycott the First Round Table Conference.
 Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
All statements are correct. The Congress session in Lahore set the stage for the Civil Disobedience Movement.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
सभी कथन सही हैं। लाहौर में कांग्रेस अधिवेशन ने सविनय अवज्ञा आंदोलन का मार्ग प्रशस्त किया।

questions.question: Who among the following called the Revolt of 1857 as the "First War of Indian Independence"?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
V.D. Savarkar popularized this term in his book published in 1909.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
वी.डी. सावरकर ने 1909 में प्रकाशित अपनी पुस्तक में इस शब्द को लोकप्रिय बनाया था।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the 'Two-Nation Theory' and Muslim League: 
(a) The idea of a separate homeland for Muslims was first proposed by Mohammad Iqbal.
(b) The term 'Pakistan' was coined by Choudhry Rahmat Ali. / '
(c) The Lahore Resolution (1940) formally demanded a separate state.
 Which of the above statements are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Iqbal spoke of a North-West Muslim state in 1930; Rahmat Ali coined the name in 1933; and Jinnah led the 1940 resolution.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
इकबाल ने 1930 में उत्तर-पश्चिम मुस्लिम राज्य की बात की थी; रहमत अली ने 1933 में यह नाम गढ़ा; और जिन्ना ने 1940 के प्रस्ताव का नेतृत्व किया।

questions.question: Which of the following was the reason for the withdrawal of the Non-Cooperation Movement in 1922?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Violent clash in Chauri Chaura (UP) led Gandhi to call off the movement as it was turning violent.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
चौरी-चौरा (यूपी) में हिंसक झड़प के कारण गांधीजी ने आंदोलन को वापस ले लिया क्योंकि यह हिंसक हो रहा था।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the 'Surat Split' and its consequences: 
(a) The British followed the policy of "Divide and Rule" by favoring the Moderates.
(b) Following the split, Tilak was sent to Mandalay jail for 6 years.
(c) The INC became weak and ineffective for almost a decade after the split.
 Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The split severely weakened the national movement until the Lucknow Pact of 1916.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
1916 के लखनऊ समझौते तक इस विभाजन ने राष्ट्रीय आंदोलन को गंभीर रूप से कमजोर कर दिया था।

questions.question: Who was known as the "Ambassador of Hindu-Muslim Unity" in the early phase of his career?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Sarojini Naidu gave this title to Jinnah due to his efforts during the Lucknow Pact

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
सरोजिनी नायडू ने लखनऊ समझौते के दौरान जिन्ना के प्रयासों के कारण उन्हें यह उपाधि दी थी।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the 'Salt Satyagraha': 
(a) Salt was chosen because it was a product used by every Indian, regardless of caste or religion.
(b) The British had a monopoly on the production and sale of salt.
(c) The tax on salt accounted for more than 50% of British India's revenue.
 Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Statement (c) is incorrect. While salt tax was burdensome for the poor, it was not 50% of the total revenue (it was approx. 8-10%).

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
कथन (c) गलत है। हालांकि नमक कर गरीबों के लिए बोझिल था, लेकिन यह कुल राजस्व का 50% नहीं था (यह लगभग 8-10% था)।

questions.question:
Arrange the following Satyagrahas of Gandhi in chronological order: 
(a) Kheda Satyagraha
(b) Champaran Satyagraha
(c) Ahmedabad Mill Strike
Choose the correct code:
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Champaran (1917), Ahmedabad (March 1918), Kheda (June 1918).

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
चंपारण (1917), अहमदाबाद (मार्च 1918), खेड़ा (जून 1918)।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements about the '1857 Revolt' in Awadh: 
(a) Awadh was annexed by the British in 1856 on grounds of misgovernance. / 1856
(b) Large numbers of sepoys in the Bengal Army were recruited from Awadh.
(c) The Taluqdars of Awadh supported the British during the revolt.
 Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Taluqdars were dispossessed of their lands after the annexation and thus mostly supported the rebels, not the British.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
विलेय के बाद ताल्लुकदारों को उनकी भूमि से बेदखल कर दिया गया था, इसलिए उन्होंने ज्यादातर विद्रोहियों का समर्थन किया, अंग्रेजों का नहीं।

questions.question: The 'Karachi Session' of 1931 is famous for which of the following?

options.a: Adoption of resolution on Fundamental Rights.

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Presided over by Vallabhbhai Patel, this session defined what 'Swaraj' would mean for the masses.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
वल्लभभाई पटेल की अध्यक्षता में, इस अधिवेशन ने परिभाषित किया कि जनता के लिए 'स्वराज' का क्या अर्थ होगा।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements about 'Annie Besant': 
(a) She was the first woman President of the INC.
(b) She founded the Home Rule League in 1916.
(c) She was the founder of the Theosophical Society.
 Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
She was the first woman President (1917). The Theosophical Society was founded by Blavatsky and Olcott; Besant joined it later and became its president.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
वह पहली महिला अध्यक्ष (1917) थीं। थियोसोफिकल सोसाइटी की स्थापना ब्लावत्स्की और ऑलकोट ने की थी; बेसेंट बाद में इसमें शामिल हुईं और इसकी अध्यक्ष बनीं।

questions.question: The 'Vande Mataram' slogan became popular during which movement?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
It became the anthem of the anti-partition agitation (Swadeshi Movement) in 1905.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
यह 1905 में विभाजन विरोधी आंदोलन (स्वदेशी आंदोलन) का गान बन गया।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the 'Round Table Conferences': 
(a) Dr. B.R. Ambedkar attended all three conferences.
(b) The Congress attended only the second conference.
(c) The conferences were held in London.
 Which of the above statements are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
All statements are correct. Gandhi represented Congress in the 2nd RTC after the Gandhi-Irwin Pact.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
सभी कथन सही हैं। गांधी-इरविन समझौते के बाद गांधीजी ने दूसरे RTC में कांग्रेस का प्रतिनिधित्व किया।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the 'Peshawar Incident' (1930): 
(a) The soldiers of the Garhwal Rifles refused to fire on the unarmed crowd.
(b) Chandra Singh Garhwali was the leader of these soldiers.
(c) This incident occurred during the Non-Cooperation Movement.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
This incident occurred during the Civil Disobedience Movement (CDM) in April 1930, not during the Non-Cooperation Movement.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
यह घटना अप्रैल 1930 में सविनय अवज्ञा आंदोलन (CDM) के दौरान हुई थी, असहयोग आंदोलन के दौरान नहीं।

questions.question: Who was the President of the Indian National Congress at the time of India's independence?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
J.B. Kripalani was the President during the transition of power in 1947.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
जे.बी. कृपलानी 1947 में सत्ता हस्तांतरण के दौरान अध्यक्ष थे।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the 'Swaraj Party': 
(a) They were known as 'Pro-changers' within the Congress.
(b) They were against entering the legislative councils.
(c) The party merged back with Congress for the 1930 elections. / 1930
 Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Swarajists were 'Pro-changers' who wanted to enter councils to disrupt British administration. They boycotted the 1930 elections as part of the CDM.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
स्वराजवादी 'परिवर्तनवादी' थे जो ब्रिटिश प्रशासन को बाधित करने के लिए परिषदों में प्रवेश करना चाहते थे। उन्होंने CDM के हिस्से के रूप में 1930 के चुनावों का बहिष्कार किया था।

questions.question:
Match the following Books/Journals with their Authors: 
 | List-I (Book/Journal) | List-II (Author) | 
 | :--- | :--- | 
| (A) The Indian War of Independence
| (B) Hind Swaraj
| (C) Why I am an Atheist
| (D) India Wins Freedom
Choose the correct code:
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
All matches represent iconic literary works of the Indian freedom struggle.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
सभी मिलान भारतीय स्वतंत्रता संग्राम की प्रतिष्ठित साहित्यिक कृतियों का प्रतिनिधित्व करते हैं।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the 'Communal Award' (1932): 
(a) It was announced by the British PM Ramsay MacDonald.
(b) It extended separate electorates to the 'Depressed Classes'.
(c) Gandhi supported the award in the Second Round Table Conference.
 Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Gandhi strongly opposed the Communal Award as he believed it would divide the Hindu society. He went on a fast unto death in Yerwada Jail.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
गांधीजी ने सांप्रदायिक अधिनिर्णय का कड़ा विरोध किया क्योंकि उनका मानना था कि यह हिंदू समाज को विभाजित कर देगा। वे यरवदा जेल में आमरण अनशन पर बैठ गए थे।

questions.question: The 1857 Revolt did not spread to which of the following regions?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
While there were isolated incidents, South India remained largely unaffected by the 1857 revolt.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
यद्यपि कुछ छिटपुट घटनाएं हुई थीं, लेकिन दक्षिण भारत 1857 के विद्रोह से काफी हद तक अप्रभावित रहा।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the 'Lucknow Pact' (1916): 
(a) It brought together the Moderates and Extremists.
(b) It was a joint agreement between the INC and the Muslim League.
(c) The Congress accepted the demand for separate electorates for Muslims.
 Which of the above statements are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The Lucknow Pact was a milestone in unity but is also criticized for accepting the communal principle of separate electorates.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
लखनऊ समझौता एकता में एक मील का पत्थर था लेकिन अलग निर्वाचक मंडल के सांप्रदायिक सिद्धांत को स्वीकार करने के लिए इसकी आलोचना भी की जाती है।

questions.question: Who was the leader of the 'Akaal Movement' associated with the Simon Commission protest?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Master Tara Singh was a prominent leader in Punjab who mobilized the Sikh community against the Simon Commission.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
मास्टर तारा सिंह पंजाब के एक प्रमुख नेता थे जिन्होंने साइमन कमीशन के खिलाफ सिख समुदाय को लामबंद किया था।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements about the 'Partition of Bengal' annulment: 
(a) The partition was annulled in 1911 by Lord Hardinge.
(b) The capital of India was shifted from Calcutta to Delhi in the same year.
(c) Bihar and Orissa were separated from Bengal in 1911. / 1911
 Which of the above statements are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The annulment was announced during the Delhi Durbar of King George V.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
विभाजन को रद्द करने की घोषणा किंग जॉर्ज पंचम के दिल्ली दरबार के दौरान की गई थी।

questions.question: In the context of the 1857 Revolt, what did the term 'Zafarnama' refer to?

options.a: The military manual of the rebels.
options.b: The proclamation issued by Bahadur Shah Zafar.
options.c: The diary of a British officer.
options.d: A collection of poems by Ghalib.

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Proclamations or 'Zafarnamas' were issued to appeal to all sections of society to unite against the British.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
समाज के सभी वर्गों से अंग्रेजों के खिलाफ एकजुट होने की अपील करने के लिए उद्घोषणाएं या 'जफरनामा' जारी किए गए थे।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the 'Poona Pact' (1932): 
(a) It was signed between Mahatma Gandhi and B.R. Ambedkar.
(b) It abandoned the idea of separate electorates for the depressed classes.
(c) The number of reserved seats for depressed classes was decreased.
 Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Statement (c) is incorrect. The number of reserved seats in provincial legislatures was increased from 71 to 147.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
कथन (c) गलत है। प्रांतीय विधानसभाओं में आरक्षित सीटों की संख्या 71 से बढ़ाकर 147 कर दी गई थी।

questions.question: Which of the following movements started with the 'Dandi March'?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The violation of salt law at Dandi on April 6, 1930, marked the beginning of the CDM.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
6 अप्रैल, 1930 को दांडी में नमक कानून के उल्लंघन ने CDM की शुरुआत को चिह्नित किया।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the '1857 Revolt' and the role of the Press: 
(a) The 'Gagging Act' of 1857 was passed to restrict the freedom of the press.
(b) Lord Canning was the Viceroy who introduced this act.
 Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The Licensing Act of 1857 (Gagging Act) required a license for operating any press, aimed at stopping the spread of rebel ideas.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
1857 के लाइसेंसिंग एक्ट (गैगिंग एक्ट) के तहत किसी भी प्रेस को चलाने के लिए लाइसेंस की आवश्यकता होती थी, जिसका उद्देश्य विद्रोही विचारों के प्रसार को रोकना था।

questions.question: Who presided over the 1906 Calcutta session where 'Swaraj' was first mentioned as a goal?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Dadabhai Naoroji mentioned 'Swaraj' as the ultimate goal of the Congress to prevent a split between Moderates and Extremists.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
नरमपंथियों और चरमपंथियों के बीच विभाजन को रोकने के लिए दादाभाई नौरोजी ने 'स्वराज' को कांग्रेस के अंतिम लक्ष्य के रूप में उल्लेख किया था।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the 'Simon Commission Report': 
(a) It recommended the continuation of communal electorates.
(b) It recommended the establishment of a federation of British India and Princely States.
(c) It rejected the idea of Universal Adult Franchise.
 Which of the above statements are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The report was published in 1930 and formed the basis for the Government of India Act 1935.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
रिपोर्ट 1930 में प्रकाशित हुई थी और इसने भारत सरकार अधिनियम 1935 का आधार बनाया था।
